summary: RedCloud Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K disclosing that on October 13, 2026 Nasdaq issued a Staff Delisting Determination after the company failed to regain compliance with the $1.00 minimum bid price rule by the October 12, 2026 deadline. Nasdaq denied a second 180-day period because RedCloud lacks the stockholders' equity required for initial listing standards, scheduling delisting effective October 22, 2026. On October 14 the company appealed to a Nasdaq Hearings Panel, staying suspension pending a hearing; it will submit a compliance plan. Watch the Panel's ruling, any reverse split or equity raise, and delisting risk if the appeal fails.
